test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 13 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which amendment to the Constitution of India changed the description of India from a 'sovereign democratic republic' to a 'sovereign, socialist secular democratic republic' and also changed the words 'unity of the nation' to 'unity and integrity of the nation'?
solution:
The correct answer is **__42__ⁿd.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **42ⁿd Amendment of the ****Constitution** of India changed the description of India from a 'sovereign democratic republic' to a 'sovereign, socialist secular democratic republic'.
 
• It also changed the words 'unity of the nation' to 'unity and integrity of the nation'.
 
• The Act is also called **The Constitution Act, 1976.**
 
• The Act is also known as **Mini** Constitution.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Some other provisions of the 42nd Amendment__**:

 
 
• It transferred five subjects from the state list to the concurrent list:
 
 
• Education,
 
• Forests,
 
• Weights & Measures,
 
• Protection of Wild Animals, and Birds
 
• Administration of Justice.
 
 
 
• **10 Fundamental Duties** added for the citizens under **Article 51A.**
 
• Curtailed the **judicial review power** of the High Courts.
 
• **Part XIV-A** added entitled ‘Tribunals dealing with Administrative matters’ and ‘Tribunals for other matters.
 
• Three new **DPSPs** (Directive Principles of State Policy) were added to the existing list of DPSPs and one was amended.
